title: HTML and CSS reference
summary: Tags and CSS you can click to insert, with what each one does.

items.label: <h1> heading
items.hint: The biggest heading. Use it once for the page title.

items.label: <h2> subheading
items.hint: A smaller heading for a section.
items.shows: A smaller heading under the title

items.label: paragraph
items.hint: A paragraph of text.
items.shows: Two paragraphs, with a gap between

items.label: <div> box
items.hint: A container that groups things together, so you can style them as one.

items.label: <ul> list
items.hint: A bulleted list. Each item is an <li>.

items.label: <ol> numbered list
items.hint: A numbered list.

items.label: comment
items.hint: A note that the browser ignores.
items.example: You can see this.

items.label: <a> link
items.hint: A link. The address goes in href; the words between the tags are what people click.
items.shows: The link text is blue and underlined

items.label: image
items.hint: An image. alt describes it for people who cannot see it.

items.label: <strong> bold
items.hint: Make text stand out as important (usually bold).
items.shows: Only the word inside is bold

items.label: <em> emphasis
items.hint: Emphasise text (usually italic).
items.shows: Only the word inside is italic

items.label: <button>
items.hint: A button.

items.label: line break
items.hint: Start a new line.
items.shows: A new line inside one paragraph

items.label: <hr> line
items.hint: Draw a line across the page.

items.label: <table>
items.hint: A table: <tr> is a row, <th> a heading cell, <td> a normal cell.
items.shows: Headings in bold, one row per <tr>

items.label: <style> block
items.hint: Where CSS lives. Each rule is: selector { property: value; }

items.label: rule
items.hint: Style every element matching the selector.

items.label: color
items.hint: The text colour.

items.label: background-color
items.hint: The background colour.

items.label: font-size
items.hint: How big the text is.

items.label: font-family
items.hint: Which font to use.

items.label: text-align
items.hint: Align text: left, center or right.
items.shows: The heading moves to the middle

items.label: padding
items.hint: Space inside an element, between its edge and its content.
items.shows: Space between the edge and the text

items.label: margin
items.hint: Space outside an element, between it and its neighbours.

items.label: border
items.hint: A line around an element: thickness, style, colour.
